title.zh: 先试信息连接，不替别人猜答案
title.en: Test an information link without guessing someone else’s answer

paragraphs.zh: 原创场景：虚构图书角的目录按书名排，架签却按主题排。你画一张两栏对照卡，先用一册书检查能否从目录找到架位；无法确认的位置标待核，不把看似相关当成同一本。与龙的整体构想相比，先补一处具体连接；与鸡的核对相比，重点是找到连接办法，仍须确认实际架位。若现有目录已经够用，不必为了像“找路人”再造捷径。
paragraphs.en: In an original scene, an invented book corner has a title-based catalogue and subject-based shelf labels. Draw a two-column cross-reference and check whether one book can be located; mark an unconfirmed location rather than equating apparently related entries. Compared with Dragon’s larger picture, connect one specific gap; alongside Rooster, the proposed link still needs checking against the shelf. If the existing catalogue works, there is no need to invent a shortcut to fit the Wayfinder.

paragraphs.en: Ask: “Whose guess does this link remove, and what still needs checking?” Use three invented book titles without real borrowing records or a speed comparison. If someone cannot follow the link, revise the cue before inferring anything about their understanding.

Repetition has a quantity and an ending, not an automatic weekly obligation. Compared with Tiger’s opening, make later versions repeatable; compared with Monkey’s variation, retain the confirmed dimensions for this round. Changed materials may require a different method rather than persistence with an obsolete step.

A first draft gives discussion an object, not an obligation to follow your direction. Compared with Dragon, start with a concrete mark; alongside Rabbit, keep entry and exit comfortable. When an opening already exists, responding to it may be more useful than starting over.

paragraphs.en: In an original scene, an invented collage invitation says every guest must introduce a piece. Suggest watching first, adding one fragment or not speaking, and confirm with the organiser that these are genuine options. Compared with Pig’s shared pause, focus on entering an activity; compared with Tiger, joining need not require a new opening. When guests understand the options and are comfortable, do not presume anxiety or arrange unsolicited care.

paragraphs.en: In an original scene, a fictional club has a map, old photographs and illustrated cards. Sketch how they might form a neighbourhood storybook, labelling proposals separately from agreed parts. Compared with Rat’s specific connection, show the larger structure; alongside Ox, the sketch still needs manageable tasks that someone accepts. Others may prefer three separate items. A coherent vision does not silently become everyone’s goal.

paragraphs.en: Ask: “What exists, what is only possible, and who has not agreed?” Map three fictional materials without fundraising or recruiting. The size of a vision is no personal ranking; the result grants neither leadership authority nor favourable fortune.

Ask which step readers need, list one supporting point and one unknown for each, then revisit in ten minutes. Both drafts may remain open. Compared with Rooster, frame the question rather than only check a fact; alongside Monkey, a reading trial can follow reflection. Enough information for a reversible choice need not become delay to fit the Reflective Planner.

paragraphs.en: Ask: “What additional information would change the choice?” Use an invented exhibit without guessing motives or disclosing private history. Longer reflection proves no greater depth, and a quicker choice proves no shallowness; counts measure neither insight nor strategic skill.

No physical trip is needed. Compared with Rat, explore a different experience rather than merely shorten a route; alongside Dog, retain an existing meeting agreement. If someone needs only a clear main path, omitting the branch is also reasonable. Freedom needs no tally of detours.

Adjust spacing to draw attention to the centre, naming this as an atmosphere proposal, then ask whether the title stays clear and the table usable. Compared with Dragon, focus on the immediate arrangement rather than the whole story; alongside Rooster, appearance does not replace checking content. Others may prefer the original layout. Taste need not become a single correct answer.

Compared with Tiger, compare versions that already exist; alongside Rooster, investigate the wording behind a difference. A few readers cannot establish which version works for everyone. If both are unclear, revising the question may be the next step.

paragraphs.en: Ask: “What exactly changed, and does the observation support the explanation?” Rearrange invented text privately if preferred, without covertly testing friends. The result proves neither cleverness, playfulness nor rule-breaking. Not observing a difference is information too.

title.zh: 核对具体出处，不把新稿自动当成定稿
title.en: Check the actual source rather than treating a newer draft as final

paragraphs.zh: 原创场景：虚构故事集的目录写第八页，正文草稿却把标题移到第九页。你标出两处不一致，问哪份版本将供阅读；确认前不自行宣布正确页码。与鼠相比，此处主要核具体引用；与蛇相比，已有明确核对对象，无需猜动机。若这一轮只讨论未排版草图，页码可能暂时无关，可记待排版时核，不持续纠正所有细节。
paragraphs.en: In an original scene, an invented storybook’s contents page points to page eight while a draft has the heading on page nine. Mark the discrepancy and ask which version will be read before declaring a correct reference. Compared with Rat, check a specific citation; compared with Snake, the source to clarify is already concrete, so motives need no guessing. Page numbers may be irrelevant during a rough-layout discussion. Record a later check rather than correcting every detail now.

title.zh: 用一个具体选择聊天，不按出生年给真人分类
title.en: Discuss a specific choice without classifying people by birth year

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“读者会用哪一版，谁能确认？”用两条编造目录练核对，不搜私人信息，也不把一处错写成人品或能力。次数不证明更诚实、更细心，修正自己的记录同样可取。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “Which version will readers use, and who can confirm it?” Check invented references without searching private information or turning an error into a judgment of character or ability. Counts prove neither honesty nor attentiveness; revising your own note is useful too.

title.zh: 守住实际约定，也允许重新商量范围
title.en: Retain the actual agreement and allow its scope to change

paragraphs.zh: 原创场景：你答应把虚构故事会的两张海报草图交给下一位，后来又被默认负责全部印制。先确认原来是交草图，再说明印制尚未约定；若不能按时交草图，应尽早告诉对方并商量调整，不假装已完成。与牛相比，重点是别人正在依赖的交接；与猪相比，愿意贡献不自动等于继续提供更多。清楚说不能承担也可以，比无条件答应更能让下一步被看见。
paragraphs.en: In an original scene, you agreed to hand over two poster sketches for an invented story evening, then printing is assumed to be your task too. Confirm the sketch agreement and clarify that printing is unagreed. If the sketches will be late, communicate and discuss a change rather than claim completion. Compared with Ox, focus on a handoff someone relies on; compared with Pig, a contribution does not automatically expand. Saying what you cannot undertake can make the next step clearer than unconditional acceptance.

title.zh: 用一个具体选择聊天，不按出生年给真人分类
title.en: Discuss a specific choice without classifying people by birth year

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“答应过的是什么，新增的是什么，哪项状态还没确认？”写一条虚构交接，不做忠诚试探、不代朋友作保证。结果不要求牺牲，也不测可信度、依恋或某年出生者的责任。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “What was agreed, what was added, and what remains unconfirmed?” Write an invented handoff without loyalty tests or guarantees on a friend’s behalf. The result requires no sacrifice and measures neither trustworthiness, attachment nor obligations attached to a birth year.

title.zh: 给共享留选择，也让结束被尊重
title.en: Leave choices within sharing and respect the ending

paragraphs.zh: 原创场景：虚构读书会结束后，你想留十分钟让大家看已完成的折页。先说明可以看看、补一句或直接离开；不用拿出食物、花钱或额外承担收拾，除非另有约定。与兔相比，此处重在已有成果如何共同停留；与狗相比，可选停歇不是每个人承诺延长活动。若大家想结束，按时收尾也可让共享有清楚边界，不需继续热场。
paragraphs.en: In an original scene, you offer ten minutes after an invented reading club to view finished folded pages. People may look, add a sentence or leave. Food, spending and extra cleanup are unnecessary unless separately agreed. Compared with Rabbit, focus on enjoying what exists; alongside Dog, an optional pause does not mean everyone promised a longer event. If people want to finish, ending on time can give sharing a clear boundary without keeping the atmosphere going.

title.zh: 用一个具体选择聊天，不按出生年给真人分类
title.en: Discuss a specific choice without classifying people by birth year

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“这里可以不贡献、只停留或离开吗？”编一句可退出的收尾邀请，也可只留给自己。不拿分享数量证明慷慨，不追问谁为什么离开；结果不说明懒散、天真或注定服务他人。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “Can someone add nothing, simply stay or leave?” Draft an optional closing invitation, privately if preferred. Contributions are no generosity score, and departure requires no explanation; the result establishes neither laziness, naivety nor a duty to serve others.
